mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by CYP2D6; tamoxifen inhibits CYP2D6 and may increase atomoxetine plasma concentrations, while atomoxetine may compete for metabolism and both carry independent cardiac risk.
action: Monitor for increased atomoxetine adverse effects (tremor, tachycardia, elevated blood pressure); consider atomoxetine dose reduction or alternative ADHD medication; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
